prompt_html: An investor pays a $1.00 premium for a put option with a $60.00 strike price when the underlying price was trading at $65.00. At expiration the stock has decreased to $55.00. What is the profit or loss on the option at expiration?

An investor pays a $1.00 premium for a put option with a $30.00 strike price when the underlying price was trading at $32.50. At expiration the stock has decreased to $25.00. What is the profit or loss on the option at expiration?
